title: ITU RDF-ASP 2026: digital inclusion and universal connectivity
discussion_signal: The post frames universal, meaningful, and affordable connectivity as an unfinished inclusion project, keeping affordability, infrastructure, skills, and sustainable participation in the same policy conversation.
linked_research_question: When basic access expands, which affordability, quality, skills, and location barriers still prevent meaningful digital participation?
limits: The post is event and policy commentary rather than a comparative connectivity dataset
It does not quantify the remaining gaps
The institutional framing emphasizes collaboration and may omit political conflict over investment and regulation
